items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: So I didn't go, Herb Ellis went with him, you know.

ctx.x: Yes, I have a lot of students who are rock and roll players, very good players, you know. They're interested in jazz. But I get most of my students from performing, and by reference. And I say half of my students come from Mundell Lowe, Herb Ellis, Barney. I get all of Barney Barnie's students because Barney Barnie's never in town. You know. Speaking of the guy in Montana, Barney performed there and the guy was -- loved Barney's playing and he wanted to study with Barney Barnie and Barney gave him my number, and…
Then he'd come back for two more weeks, but this is how I get most of my students, from guitarists.
